patthana18.4:1.1: nahetu appaccayo dhammo na nahetussa na appaccayassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo: …pe… na hetussa na appaccayassa dhammassa ārammaṇa …pe… na hetussa na appaccayassa ca na nahetussa na appaccayassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo:.
patthana18.4:2.1: ārammaṇe tīṇi. asaṅkhataṃ appaccayasadisaṃ …pe… hetuduka sanidassanaduke nahetuduka nasanidassanadukaṃ
patthana18.4:3.1: nahetu sanidassano dhammo na nahetussa na sanidassanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo: .. na hetussa na sanidassanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo: .. na hetussa na sanidassanassa ca na nahetussa na sanidassanassa ca dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo:. ārammaṇe tīṇi.
patthana18.4:4.1: hetuṃ anidassanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na anidassano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. hetuduka sappaṭighaduke nahetuduka nasappaṭighadukaṃ
patthana18.4:5.1: nahetuṃ sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana18.4:6.1: hetuṃ appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. hetuduka rūpīduke nahetuduka narūpīdukaṃ
patthana18.4:7.1: nahetuṃ rūpiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na nahetu na rūpī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.4:8.1: hetuṃ arūpiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na arūpī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. hetuduka lokiyaduke nahetuduka nalokiyadukaṃ
patthana18.4:9.1: nahetuṃ lokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na nahetu na lokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana18.4:10.1: hetuṃ lokuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na lokuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. hetuduka kenaciviññeyyaduke nahetuduka nakenaciviññeyyadukaṃ
patthana18.4:11.1: hetuṃ kenaciviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na kenaciviññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā nava.
patthana18.4:12.1: hetuṃ kenacinaviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na kenacinaviññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā nava. hetuduka āsavaduke nahetuduka noāsavadukaṃ
